title: A3 agent output (a3-passage-splitter)
description: Section 9/A3 'Agent output' line and the a3-passage-splitter agent file (Appendix B): lists of block numbers only, no text (Rule 5 — the script cuts).

passages.description: Each inner array is the block numbers (in reading order) that make up one passage. Every block number from the input must appear in exactly one passage (the A3 check).
